deviations: The placement sink in strategies/legacy.py repeats the body of supervisor/scheduler/orders.py::_place_candidates for one intent. orders.py and serve.py are CHIEF-owned and read-only for this plan, and _place_candidates iterates trading.candidates, so it cannot take an intent. The sink imports private helpers (_await_order, _replay_trade, _replay_trading, _run_exit_rules, _ReplayTrading) from the scheduler package. CHIEF should confirm this coupling or offer a public seam.

The exit pass and the risk halt check run from the driver's before/after stamp hooks, not as strategies. The runtime itself stays generic. Parity holds on smoke because the order of draws from the shared RNG matches run_once_replay: decision id at the BUY tick, then approval id, correlation, adapter latency; exit rules after each stamp.
Parity is proven on tests/fixtures/replay/smoke only. The other seats of the timeline are not driven; they write no trade rows.

LegacyScreening moved from registry.py to strategies/legacy.py as the 15-02 receipt asked. registry.py re-exports it. Constructor takes optional keyword arguments. Built with no arguments it is unbound and on_tick returns (), so the 15-02 assertion in tests/strategies/test_registry.py still holds without editing that file.

TickSnapshot.price_lamports is the fixture's curve reserve S (lamports in curve), used as an integer price proxy. The per-token price S/T is fractional and cannot be an integer lamport value. 15-04 strategies must be reviewed against this choice.

Per-strategy P&L is folded from ledger rows, attributing each row's equity change to its ticket's strategy via strategy_ticket_refs, or to the desk. The plan text also mentions folding strategy_state snapshots. That fold is not implemented here; the criterion needs only that the attributed buckets equal the desk total, which attribute() checks before returning.

LedgerStore.append_batch gained an optional keyword-only sidecar writer that runs inside the same transaction before COMMIT. append() is unchanged. No event model, NoteKind value or event field changed.
Tape and allocation tests sit inside the plan-named files (test_attribution.py, test_allocation.py). No extra test files were added.
Decision ids are minted by the runtime's IdFactory at the BUY tick, which is what the parity depends on. Intent.decision_id therefore carries a real ULID that the sink passes to exec.place unchanged.
